site.tagline: Instant Care for Life's Biggest Journey

hero.title: Instant Care for Life's Biggest Journey
hero.body: Connecting women and families with experienced midwives for expert advice, care and support from pregnancy to early parenthood, all delivered via WhatsApp, straight to your phone.

who.title: Who I Am
who.subtitle: Your Instant Midwife
who.name: Tasmin
who.body: With over 18 years of midwifery experience, I bring specialist expertise in hypnobirthing, complementary therapies and parent education — so you're supported by a midwife who truly understands the full picture of pregnancy.

packages.title: MIM Core Support
features: A foundational package giving you consistent midwife support throughout your pregnancy.
Daily Email — A gentle daily touchpoint designed to steady anxious thoughts, answer common questions, and offer reassurance you can trust.
WhatsApp Access — Direct access to a midwife via WhatsApp, Monday-Friday 9am-5pm.
Monthly Call — One scheduled 1-hour call per month within service hours.

packages.title: MIM Signature Support
features: Enhanced support with extended midwife access for those who want more reassurance, more often.
Daily Email — A gentle daily touchpoint designed to steady anxious thoughts, answer common questions, and offer reassurance you can trust.
WhatsApp Access — Direct access to a midwife via WhatsApp, seven days a week, 7am-11pm.
Monthly Calls — Two scheduled 1-hour calls per month within service hours.

packages.title: MIM Sustained Support
packages.note: 10 months continuous care (equivalent to £140/month) • available from booking around 6-8 weeks of pregnancy
features: Complete continuity of care from early pregnancy through to the postpartum period.
Full Signature-Level Support — Everything included in MIM Signature Support.
Antenatal Education — Structured education through downloadable resources.
Extended Postnatal Support — Support through infant feeding, recovery, and early parenthood.

courses.title: Biomechanics in Labour
courses.subtitle: How Your Body Moves, How Your Baby Navigates
courses.body: Birth is a mechanical event — your baby navigates your pelvis through a series of movements. This course reveals the three sections of the pelvis, rebozo techniques, daily habits from 34 weeks, and what to do at each stage of labour.

courses.title: The Baby Moon
courses.subtitle: 40 Days of Postpartum Nourishment
courses.body: The first 40 days after birth are sacred in cultures worldwide — a time for retreat, warmth, nourishment, and deep restoration.

courses.title: Hypnobirthing
courses.subtitle: A Complete Guide for You and Your Birth Partner
courses.body: Evidence-based techniques to break the fear-tension-pain cycle. Learn breathing, relaxation, partner support, birth preferences, and fourth-trimester preparation.

footer.questionBody: Get in touch to find out more about our services and how we can support you
